Reading

Read quickly

A How many friends does Tom talk about?

4: Alex, Sara, Ali and Hany

My name is Tom. I am a student. I have many friends. We are at university today.

I have a backpack. My backpack is blue and big. In my backpack, I have my books, my notebook, and my pencil case because I have many classes today. My phone is always in my pocket. I also have my water bottle in my bag, so my bag is heavy.

My best friend is Alex. Alex has his own backpack. His backpack is black. In his bag, he has his laptop and his headphones. His phone is new, and his watch is very nice.

I also have a friend named Sara. Sara likes her personal stuff very much. Her bag is small and red. In her bag, she has her keys, her wallet, and her makeup. Her phone is always in her hand. Ali and Hany don’t have any books. They have phones to take notes. Their phones are very smart.

We meet every day. We bring our bags and our things with us. We like our friends, and we like sharing our time together.

Read and answer

Question 1 / 4 B
What color is Tom’s backpack?
Blue (and big).
Question 2 / 4 C
What does he have in his backpack?
His books, his notebook, his pencil case, and his water bottle.
Question 3 / 4 D
Who is his best friend? What color is his friend’s backpack?
His best friend is Alex. Alex’s backpack is black.
Question 4 / 4 A
What does Sara have in her bag?
Her keys, her wallet, and her makeup.

Look at the text

I have a backpack. My backpack is blue.
Alex has a backpack. His backpack is black.
Sara has a bag. Her bag is red.
Ali and Hany have phones. Their phones are smart.
We have bags. Our bags are with us.
